name: secret_env_keeps_path
description: While the secret vault holds a value, commands (foreground and background) still see PATH and the other normal environment variables, plus the EVREN_SECRET_n variable; the raw secret never reaches the model. Old bug: the child environment was replaced by just the secret variables instead of merged into os.environ, so PATH disappeared and tools such as python/npm/git were no longer found.
user_inputs: API'ye bağlan: token=fake-secret-for-tests-123 ve ortamı kontrol et.

arguments.command: import os; print('FG_PATH=' + str('PATH' in os.environ) + ' SECRET=' + str(bool(os.environ.get('EVREN_SECRET_1'))))
import os; print('BG_PATH=' + str('PATH' in os.environ) + ' SECRET=' + str(bool(os.environ.get('EVREN_SECRET_1'))))

model_replies.content: Ortam değişkenleri iki yolda da doğru.
